auth.title: Sign in to Fleetwright

errors.code: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.expired: That step expired. Start again with your email and password.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.lockoutNote: After 5 failed codes the account locks for 15 minutes (planned behaviour).
auth.liveNote: Your password and code go only to this site's API. Repeated failed attempts lock sign-in for a while.

board.name: Fleet Freight Exchange
board.tagline: Owned freight exchange for authorized workflow verification. No commercial freight is offered.
board.otpBody: A destination sign-in uses an emailed six-digit code. This local interface retains its input in the browser.
board.feedNote: New loads appear in real time. Book fast — so does everyone else.

board.captchaBody: Owned arithmetic challenges are used for verification. Third-party challenges require authorized human handling.
